blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The National Bureau of Investigation (NBI) has tapped Meta to trace the identities of the individuals behind at least 30 accounts supposedly mocking the disability and sexual orientation of Akbayan Rep. Percival Cendaña on social media, Director Melvin Matibag said. This is in response to the complaint of Cendaña, a stroke survivor and openly gay man, seeking the help of the NBI to probe the online accounts—including those of Cho Moreno, MP Miko Pogay, and Kiffy Chu—supposedly posting numerous content that could violate the Magna Carta of Disabled Persons and the Safe Spaces Act.
